title: 阿卡丽·热面小憩
description: 高马尾阿卡丽穿保暖忍者便服坐在矮桌边吃面，标志武器安放在墙边架上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Akali is an adult Ionian ninja with a high dark ponytail, sharp green eyes, a green cloth face covering resting below her chin, and recognizable green and purple clothing accents. Give her a fully covering long-sleeved fitted jacket, opaque trousers, wraps, and soft boots. Her curved kama and kunai are safely secured on a small wooden equipment rack.
art_direction.scene: She sits sideways on a cushion at a small noodle stall table, carefully lifting a short bundle of noodles while blowing gently toward the warm bowl. A single bamboo screen and round hanging lamp suggest the setting without writing. Her relaxed shoulders, tidy chopsticks, and tucked feet make the scene a quiet meal between ordinary errands.
art_direction.palette: sage green, plum purple, warm noodle gold, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
